policy: Artist identity is a hard constraint. Automated discovery may search multiple public sources, but publication imagery is used only when the subject is independently matched and rights/permission are documented. Instagram, Meta and Google can be discovery or owner-supplied sources; the system never blindly scrapes and republishes copyrighted social imagery.
